cases.name: Danielle Lynn Kehl
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Danielle grew up in Graham participating in FFA and 4H. Danielle, or Danni, was a handful right from the beginning. Didn’t even give the doctor time to get his gloves on for her arrival. From, as a small child, spitting at her dad as he tried to take a picture of her getting her bath or mouthing at him the whole time he is “trying” to give her a good old-fashioned spanking to growing up and the mouthing never ending. As she grew older, you might have seen her painting, or repainting, a fence or moving rocks from the pasture and conning whoever she could into helping, if you know, you know.

Behind all that mouthing, though, was a very strong, crazy and happy daughter, granddaughter, sister, wife, mom, aunt and friend. She loved BIG and truly would do whatever she could to help anyone. She especially LOVED her family BIG.

Danielle married Billy Kehl on July 10, 2010. She had 3 boys, Kaidyn, Kylar, and Keylan and spent hours upon hours and miles upon miles going to and from all of their activities. Danielle also had many talents. She had her CDL license and drove a water truck for the oilfield. She was also a caregiver in her career. Most recently she had found her talent for making t-shirts and thermal cups. However her favorite and most rewarding job was being a mom to her 3 boys.

Danielle also lived in a zoo. No, really. She had chickens, a cow, goats, 2 cats, 8 or 10 dogs, a tiny rabbit and a chinchilla. All of this also kept her and the boys very busy.

Danielle truly was an amazing woman and will be so dearly missed by so many."
